rule: launch verification is scoped per command class; G03 measures the metadata-only class and its falsification condition is any read below

classes.verifies: nothing beyond the OS exec of the core; prints compile-time embedded release metadata
classes.g03Falsification: any openat/exec outside the core binary, libSystem/libc and the tty during --help/--version

classes.verifies: reads trust, registry, lock, journals and profile observations; evaluates report-only
mustNotOpen: any file for writing under the install root
any helper process (macOS loader cdhash is computed in-core)
classes.tcbPredicate: observed and reported; UNDETERMINED never refuses doctor itself

classes.verifies: open-then-verify of every executed or loaded closure member on its opened fd (the core itself and the component binaries about to run), not an eager hash of the whole inventory
classes.tcbPredicate: unprivileged launch predicate from the profile acquisition.launch list; refusal per NT-TCB rules
classes.journalOpen: reconciliation with writes under the operation lease
